english.title: Leave / place an unattended animal on a tram / a tramstop / the Information Centre on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY HE ANIMAL..), left or placed it unattended on a part of

(A)_[a tram, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAM..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 18(6) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
